as_told.title: Kelly Johnson and Lockheed crew see elliptical object

plain: Kelly Johnson, an aircraft engineer who led Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design shop of the company Lockheed, is said to have watched a strange black object in the sky. Michels reads from an account that says that at about 5 p.m. Johnson was looking out a large west-facing window at the sunset when "he watched this black thing." A commentator named Marik von Rennenkampff, calling Johnson the best-known aeronautical engineer in American history, says Johnson saw the object from his ranch in Southern California near the Channel Islands, that a Lockheed crew saw it too, and that it was elliptical. They tell it because a witness of Johnson's standing is hard to wave away.
